curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42048-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds this kart, finished on page 80, with the gear lever's three positions on page 81; book 2, omr/instructions/42048-1-2.pdf, builds the alternate model)

functions.does: The steering wheel steers the front wheels: the column's foot carries a short liftarm with a half pin in the long beam that ties the two front hubs' pivots together, so turning the wheel slides the beam sideways and turns both hubs.
functions.source: book: steering steps 38-43 (pages 44-46, the tie beam and its pins; the inset on page 46 shows it from above), steering column and wheel (pages 49-53); inferred: how the column's liftarm drives the beam

functions.does: The red gear lever on the seat's left has three positions, 1, N and 2: it turns a cross shaft under the seat, whose liftarm on the right side pushes a black link back to rock the changeover catch at the back, which slides the driving ring on the rear axle to lock one of the two 16-tooth clutch gears to the axle, or neither.
functions.source: book: rear axle and gearbox (pages 4-16), step 66 (page 66, the link), page 81 (the lever in positions 1, N and 2)
functions.note: unsure: which side of the ring is gear 1 and which gear 2

functions.does: With a gear engaged, pushing the kart along runs its one-cylinder engine: the rear axle turns the engaged clutch gear, which drives a 16-tooth gear on one of two short shafts; one shaft drives the upper shaft through a pair of 16-tooth gears, the other through an 8-tooth gear on the upper shaft's 24-tooth gear, and the 24-tooth gear turns the 12-tooth bevel gear on the crankshaft, so the piston goes up and down. One gear runs the engine three times as fast as the other; in N the engine stays still.
functions.source: book: rear axle and gearbox (pages 4-16), engine steps 49-57 and 63-68 (pages 52-69), page 81 (the gear diagrams beside each lever position); inferred: the ratios, from the gears
functions.note: in N, the rear wheels, axle and driving ring turn but the clutch gears, shafts and engine stay; unsure which way the lever must go for a gear

functions.does: The four wheels roll; the rear wheels share one axle (made of two 7-long axles joined by the driving ring's joiner), and the front wheels turn on their hubs.

questions.question: Which way does each lever go for which function? The `first` amounts in this file are guesses.
